raw.title: SIG Liaison and Ambassador Guide
raw.body:
This PR adds a SIG Liaison and Ambassador Guide — a one-page, non-technical reference that helps SIG liaisons introduce the OpenAPI Specification to industry standards groups and explain the value of alignment to leadership and partner organizations.

It is intended as a general community resource for liaisons across SIGs (referenced from SPECIAL_INTEREST_GROUPS.md). Happy to adjust the file location or wording per maintainer preference.

Authors: Pooja Vijay Kumar, Sandeep Chakravartty
